title: H2OFlows Reach Ingest v1
description: Public interoperability schema for pushing reach (river run) data into H2OFlows. Designed for partner data providers such as American Whitewater. Scope v1: geometry + map features + descriptions/rapids/access. Out of scope v1: photos, trip reports, user-generated content (gated to v2).

source.description: Partner slug for attribution and conflict tracking. Examples: 'aw', 'cdec', 'partner:foo'. Assigned by H2OFlows on partner onboarding.

submitted_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the partner generated this payload. Optional; H2OFlows defaults to ingest time.

external_id.description: Stable identifier in the partner's system. Used for idempotent upsert. Example: AW reach ID.

external_url.description: Partner-side detail URL. Rendered on the reach page as 'Also on {partner}'.

name.description: Canonical run name. Combined with put-in/take-out if present, e.g. 'Browns Canyon (Hecla Junction to Stone Bridge)'.

common_name.description: Short colloquial name if different from `name`. Optional. Example: 'Browns'.

river_name.description: River the reach is on. If omitted, H2OFlows derives via GNIS reverse lookup on put-in coord.

region.description: US state postal code (uppercase 2-letter). Required for v1.

basin.description: Drainage basin name. If omitted, H2OFlows derives via PostGIS containment against HUC8 basins.

class_max.description: Hardest rapid class on the run, as float. e.g. 3.5 for III+, 4 for IV. Values 0-6.

class_at_high.description: Optional: hardest class at high water.

multi_day_days.description: If multi-day, number of days. Null/omit for single-day runs.

length_mi.description: Run length in miles. If omitted, H2OFlows derives from geometry.

gradient_fpm.description: Average gradient in feet per mile. If omitted, H2OFlows derives from elevation profile lookup.

geometry.description: GeoJSON LineString of the run centerline, ordered put-in → take-out. Coordinates are [lng, lat]. WGS84. First coord = put-in, last coord = take-out.

comids.description: Optional list of NHDPlus ComIDs traversed by the centerline, in upstream→downstream order. If omitted, H2OFlows derives via NLDI flowline trace.

gauges.description: Gauges associated with this reach. If omitted, H2OFlows proposes nearest USGS gauge within 25 mi of put-in; partner confirms or rejects.

flow_ranges.description: Flow band thresholds. Three bands: low / running / high. See FlowRange schema for required fields per band.

external_id.description: Gauge ID in the source system. USGS = site number (e.g. '07091200'). DWR = abbrev (e.g. 'ARKSALCO').

name.description: Human-readable gauge name. If omitted, H2OFlows fetches from source.

is_primary.description: Whether this is the primary flow gauge for the reach. Exactly one gauge per reach should be primary.

label.description: Three-band model. `low` = below recommended, `running` = recommended, `high` = above recommended.

min_value.description: CFS threshold lower bound. Required for `running` and `high`. Omit for `low`.

max_value.description: CFS threshold upper bound. Required for `low` and `running`. Omit for `high`.
